At the time of event, he didn't come, instead he gave contract to some 2nd person, who booked a 3rd person, a college student to photoshoot & videograph my haldi & sangeet ceremony. During the event, I had to ask the photographer to click pictures as he wasn't doing his job & was roaming outside. I was sure that this 3rd person isn't doing his job & I raised this to Atesh. But he wasn't bothered about it as he has already got his advance payment. Finally when the time came to share all the pics & videos, I had to chase Atesh for more than a month & on top, Atesh started talking rudely on me instead of agreeing on his fault & delay. Lastly, the 2nd person who got the contract from Atesh had to call me bcz he didn't not get any payment from Atesh & Atesh was not receiving his calls too. So,I had to make entire payment to this 2nd person also, in order to get my pics & videos. When I saw the pics & videos, it was PATHETIC. There were NO videos at all, only 30-50 second clips that too from a corner. Not even a single photo captured with proper angle, lights etc. ATESH RUINED MY HALDI & SANGEET CEREMONY. I AM THINKING TO LODGE AN FIR AGAINST HIM FOR RUINING MY LIFETIME MEMORIES WITH HIS PATHETIC FRAUD SERVICE.

Our album is less a collection of photos and more a cinematic narrative of our day. If you want a photographer who doesn't just document an event but feels it and translates that emotion into stunning, timeless art, look no further. Samarth Creative Studio offers emotional resonance in every frame.Thankyou Swapnil and Team for making our memories memorable 🔥🔥❤️❤️
